The Amaranthine

The Core Setting Book

How to use this book

The Amaranthine is the core setting book, found under Travel in the web client. Begin with its voices and reference guide, then read the region or kind of place your characters will encounter.

  • Get your bearings: Preface: Three Voices, then Reference and Navigation, then The Cartomancer's Compass. Use the opening chapters to understand the book’s perspectives and organization.
  • Prepare life and travel: On Obligation and Trade, then Travel Reference. Read the setting context alongside the SRD or GM Guide’s journey procedure.
  • Choose a region: The Amaranthine Sea & Northern Shores. Use this or another regional chapter as your campaign’s starting point.
  • Go beyond settled places: The Spaces Between, then The Wilds, Dungeons, and Ways Between. Read the material relevant to the next destination rather than every possible location.

The complete chapter list follows. You can return here whenever you need a different route through the book.
